acceptance_criteria.statement: Business subscription plans bill monthly on the configured `billing_cycle_day` via QPay payment link and persist plan, location, and billing-state history per account.
Family Plan subscription grants household service history, saved favorites, and priority matching to Pro-subscribed providers behind customer-facing entitlement checks.
Recurring billing, renewal failure handling, and entitlement revocation are auditable and feature-gated so disabled plans do not expose purchase or renewal surfaces.
